details: U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experienced their largest single-day net outflow since January 29, totaling $648.6 million on May 18. This significant redemption followed a week of over $1 billion in outflows, ending a six-week streak of positive inflows. BlackRock's IBIT was among the funds with substantial withdrawals. Analysts link the decline to geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices, and broader macroeconomic uncertainties.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Massive Outflows Amid Market Uncertainty

details: Approximately one-tenth of U.S. adults reported using or investing in cryptocurrencies in 2025, marking the highest level of engagement in three years, according to a Federal Reserve report on household economic well-being. This represents an increase from 2023 and 2024 figures, although it remains below the 12% adoption rate recorded in 2021. The report details various crypto uses, including investment and payments.
title: US Crypto Adoption Reaches Three-Year High in 2025

details: Bitcoin's derivatives market is exhibiting diverging signals, suggesting an overall weakening structure. Data from Glassnode indicates a substantial 848.7% plummet in the cumulative volume delta (CVD) for spot markets, signifying a shift in selling pressure. Despite a 4.2% increase in spot trading volume, suggesting heightened activity, open interest has slightly decreased by 2.9%, reflecting cautious leverage use in an uncertain environment.
title: Bitcoin Derivatives Show Diverging Signals, Weakening Structure

details: Ethereum is at the forefront of the $65 billion real-world asset (RWA) tokenization sector, as various blockchains compete for institutional tokenization flows. This highlights growing institutional interest in bringing traditional assets onto blockchain networks, with Ethereum emerging as a leading platform for these initiatives.
title: Ethereum Leads $65 Billion Real-World Asset (RWA) Tokenization Race

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has filed a lawsuit against Minnesota concerning the state's explicit ban on prediction markets. This regulatory action signals ongoing tensions between federal and state authorities regarding the legal framework and oversight of emerging financial instruments within the crypto space.
title: CFTC Sues Minnesota Over State Ban on Prediction Markets
